dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is it you're doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: I consider myself a bard of the old school, so of course I'm here to get some inspiration.

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: That said, I've never gone down into a mine before... and in my hurry to get here, I wound up... pulling a muscle.
